title: Test backend SSE global workspace invalidation after file-event receiver lag
outcome: An SSE-level regression observes the recovery frame when the real file-event broadcast receiver falls behind, proving empty-path subtree coverage and the current file-event revision used by UI ordering.
acceptance: A regression drives real file-event broadcast receiver lag through the SSE handler and asserts a workspaceFilesChanged recovery frame containing empty path and kind subtree.
The asserted recovery revision is current and the test discriminates missing, stale or incorrectly scoped recovery without timing-only assumptions.
